overview.overview:
Montana is forecast to vote Republican in 2028, with an expected margin of about 13.5 points. The state backed the Republican ticket by 16.4 points in 2020 and by 19.9 points in 2024, and its partisan lean sits well to the right of the national average.

The plausible range runs from a Republican edge of about 4 points to one of about 23 points. A modest national shift toward the Democrats narrows the expected gap by roughly 5.5 points, but that is not enough to make the state competitive. Montana is not projected to decide the Electoral College. No state-level polls are currently available.
overview.watch: A sustained shift in national conditions or a large move in Montana-specific polling would be needed to change the outlook here.
key_factors: Montana voted Republican by wide margins in both 2020 and 2024.
The state's partisan lean is substantially more Republican than the nation as a whole.
A modeled national shift toward Democrats narrows but does not close the expected gap.
No state-level polling is currently available to test the forecast.
